page.notes: The word "censoriã" in the first line is uncertain; the mark over the a may be a printing flaw. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout (the scan shows f-like forms, e.g. "pcffe", "fatalissimo", "ipfa"), so "pcffe" is read as "posse", "poteft" as "potest", "ipfa" as "ipsa". The "28" before "9." is set in the text line and is kept there. The printed hyphen at "con-" is kept; the catchword "fidere" completes the word on the next page.
